# Wiqonn

> AI lab of data and software based in Barranquilla, Colombia. We audit, build
> and operate AI solutions for companies of any size, anywhere in the world.

## Who we are

- AI lab operated from Barranquilla, Colombia.
- Full-stack coverage: from data to hardware (AI, data, cloud, IoT, embedded systems).
- Applied research: we evaluate models on real data with academic rigor.
- Working languages: Spanish and English.

## What we do

- AI and Machine Learning: AI agents, LLM/RAG, computer vision, predictive models.
- Business Intelligence: dashboards, automated reports, real-time KPI tracking.
- Cloud and Infrastructure: multi-cloud, high availability, production-grade security.
- Custom Development: web and mobile apps, APIs, MLOps.

## How we work

- AI Readiness Audit: use-case prioritization by ROI and a roadmap with costs.
- Outcome-based pilots: KPI defined and measurable from day one.
- Managed AI Ops: managed operations, monitoring and retraining with SLA.
- Fractional AI Leadership: AI direction and CTO-as-a-service.
- IP / White-Label: licensed solutions for integrators.
